## Why it matters

Allmaps is an open-source set of browser-based tools for exploring, curating, and georeferencing IIIF-enabled digitized maps from collections worldwide.

By aligning historical maps with real-world locations and comparing maps across institutions and periods, it helps researchers investigate changing landscapes and make dispersed map collections more accessible—without requiring GIS software or downloading image files.
